nodes.label: AI Rate Limiting & Backpressure Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Prevents end-of-semester spike of teachers generating rapor simultaneously from hitting AI API rate limits and blowing the cost budget; combines queue, concurrency limiter, priority queue, budget guard, daily caps, exponential backoff, fallback model, and batching.

nodes.label: Free Tier Abuse Protection
nodes.rationale: Combines reCAPTCHA v3, IP rate limits, device fingerprinting, disposable email blocking, phone verification, and usage-pattern detection to stop users from cycling free accounts to bypass generation quotas.

nodes.label: Own Data Filter Pattern
nodes.rationale: Guru access is scoped by matching user_id on records so teachers only see/modify their own classes and documents; Admin bypasses this filter to see all data; Kepala Sekolah gets read-only visibility across all teachers without write access.
